description: Jurisdiction profiles for the GCC comparison engine. Each figure carries a review status. 'verified' = confirmed against a primary or Big-4 source during review; 'verified_secondary' = consistent across advisory sources; 'pending_verification' = reported but not confirmed; 'draft_law' = not yet enacted.

corporate_tax.applies_to: All taxable persons; 0% on qualifying income of Qualifying Free Zone Persons

withholding_tax.note: 0% WHT on domestic and cross-border payments

transfer_pricing.regime: Full OECD-aligned regime: arm's length, master/local file, disclosure form

corporate_tax.applies_to: Non-Saudi/non-GCC share of profits; Saudi/GCC share subject to zakat

zakat.note: 2.5% of zakat base (Hijri year); 2.577683% for Gregorian year; applies to Saudi/GCC-owned share

withholding_tax.note: 5% to 20% by payment type (dividends 5%, royalties 15%, management fees 20%)

dmtt.note: No DMTT enacted as of last review
dmtt.source: PwC Middle East Economy Watch Feb 2025

transfer_pricing.regime: Full regime incl. zakat payers (from 2024); master/local file, CbCR

corporate_tax.applies_to: No general CIT; 46% on oil and gas. Draft law for 10% CIT on resident companies expected from FY 2027 (not enacted as of Oct 2026).
corporate_tax.source: NBR announcement 30 Dec 2025; KPMG Bahrain Tax News Oct 2026

vat.source: VAT rate increased 5% to 10% on 1 Jan 2022

withholding_tax.note: None currently; draft CIT law contemplates WHT on Bahrain-source income of non-residents (dividends expected 0%)

transfer_pricing.regime: Limited; TP documentation expected with DMTT/CIT

corporate_tax.applies_to: All companies; 3% for qualifying small enterprises; 55% petroleum
corporate_tax.source: Income Tax Law (RD 28/2009) as amended; Deloitte Oman Highlights 2026

withholding_tax.note: 10% on royalties, management fees, R&D, software, services; WHT on dividends and interest suspended

transfer_pricing.regime: Arm's length principle; CbCR for large groups

personal_income_tax.note: 5% on annual income above OMR 42,000 reported effective 2028 (RD 56/2025). Earlier reports of postponement; confirm status.

corporate_tax.applies_to: Share of profits attributable to non-Qatari/non-GCC owners; 35% petroleum
corporate_tax.source: Law No. 24 of 2018; PwC Tax Summaries

vat.note: GCC VAT framework signatory; not implemented

withholding_tax.note: 5% on services, royalties, interest, commissions paid to non-residents without a PE

dmtt.source: Law No. 22 of 2024; ER amendments 12 Feb 2026

corporate_tax.applies_to: Foreign corporate bodies carrying on business in Kuwait; Kuwaiti/GCC-owned companies exempt (subject to NLST/Zakat/KFAS levies)
corporate_tax.source: Decree No. 3 of 1955 as amended by Law No. 2 of 2008

zakat.note: 1% of net profit for Kuwaiti shareholding companies (Zakat Law No. 46 of 2006); plus 2.5% NLST for listed companies

vat.note: GCC VAT framework signatory; not implemented

withholding_tax.note: No formal WHT; 5% tax retention on payments to contractors until tax clearance

dmtt.source: Decree-Law issued 31 Dec 2024 (reported as Law No. 157 of 2024; number unconfirmed); ER July 2025

transfer_pricing.regime: Limited; arm's length under DMTT rules
